name: battery_status
description: Battery health and charge. Returns wear level, cycle count, percentage, status. Use for battery, charge, power, wear.

name: disk_health
description: Disk SMART health. Returns model, health PASSED/FAILED, temperature, percentage used, hours. Requires pkexec. Use for disk health, SMART, NVMe.

name: disk_usage
description: Disk usage. Returns df -h for mounted filesystems. Use for disk usage, free space, storage, partition.

name: uptime_info
description: System uptime. Returns uptime -p and boot time. Use for uptime, boot time, how long running.

name: hostname_info
description: Host identity. Returns hostname, kernel version, distro. Use for hostname, host, kernel, distro, OS.

name: system_info
description: Kernel system data. Returns uname -a. Use for system info, uname, kernel details.

name: get_time
description: Current date and time. Returns YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS. Use for time, date, clock, what time is it.
